hookups.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/shawnee-state-park/stay ('Many sites have electric service and some have full-hookup service, which includes sewer, water, and electricity') + ReserveAmerica per-site catalog for parkId 880313 (28 public sites list 50-amp: the 16 Full-Hookup, 2 Great Gathering and some Modern Electric; 84 more list 30-amp), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 198 campsites on the booking site (94 Modern Electric, 86 Modern Non-Electric, 16 Full-Hookup, 2 two-unit Great Gathering full-hookup sites) besides 3 camping cottages; DCNR says 'approximately 200'. Max vehicle lengths run 10 to 45 ft (the two-unit Great Gathering sites 50); about 30 sites take 40 ft or more, and there are about 19 pull-throughs.

sites.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/shawnee-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880313 (site list and each site's details page: Max Vehicle Length, driveway type), read 2026-10-20

facilities.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/shawnee-state-park/stay ('a sanitary dump station and centrally located shower houses with flush toilets, showers, and large utility sinks'), read 2026-10-20

min_stay.season: Memorial Day weekend - Labor Day weekend

values.note: Campsites can be booked up to 11 months ahead and for the same day (ReserveAmerica booking window). 'If reserving a Saturday during the summer season, a two-night minimum stay is required.' Up to 14 consecutive nights Memorial Day to Labor Day, 21 the rest of the year.

booking.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/shawnee-state-park/stay (minimum and maximum stay) + https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/shawnee-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880313 (Booking Window: 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 11 Month(s) in advance'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed the inherited reservable/ReserveAmerica/11-month window/Saturday 2-night summer minimum/14-night max for this park; season (mid-April to late December) already manual. Added 50-amp electric with water+sewer at the full-hookup sites, 198 sites to 45 ft with pull-throughs, showers/flush toilets/dump. Not stated for this park: the noon same-day cutoff (RA only says 'for today'), fcfs. Fees left as recorded (statewide table; nothing on these pages).
